summary: QueryClient's fetchQuery, prefetchQuery, ensureQueryData, fetchInfiniteQuery, prefetchInfiniteQuery and ensureInfiniteQueryData (and the FetchQueryOptions/EnsureQueryDataOptions/EnsureInfiniteQueryDataOptions types) are deprecated in favor of the new queryClient.query() / queryClient.infiniteQuery() (with staleTime: 'static' for the ensure* variants)
The experimental_prefetchInRender QueryClient/query option and the promise property on useQuery/useInfiniteQuery results (for use with React use()) are removed

usePrefetchQuery and usePrefetchInfiniteQuery now run through queryClient.query()/infiniteQuery() instead of prefetchQuery()/prefetchInfiniteQuery(), so they honor enabled: false, skipToken and select (no fetch when disabled) where they used to fetch regardless

The TData type parameter of UseInfiniteQueryOptions and UseSuspenseInfiniteQueryOptions now defaults to InfiniteData<TQueryFnData> instead of TQueryFnData, so options typed with the defaults describe the paginated shape

hydrate()/HydrationBoundary no longer fall back for dehydrated queries without dehydratedAt (now a required field of the dehydrated query type): such entries no longer count as newer data or get dataUpdatedAt = now, and their pending promises are not picked up
